newsitem.title: RUSSIA: City of Moscow to issue next Eurobond in autumn.
newsitem.headline: City of Moscow to issue next Eurobond in autumn.

text.p: The City of Moscow will make its next Eurobond issue at the end of September or start of October, a city government source said on Thursday.

"The next Eurobond will happen in autumn, at the end of September or start of October," the source told Reuters. He said the volume would be about the same as in the first issue, which amounted to $500 million. There was no official comment from the government.
The City of Moscow made its debut Eurobond issue in May. It was the first Russian entity apart from the Russian Federation to tap international markets.
The three-year issue was priced to yield 315 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
